On Wed, 25 Mar 2026 at 09:18, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We have verbal acceptance from Jordan (via Atlas Talent) pending a formal offer...

Notes from hiring manager POV: 
- Candidate is strong on distributed systems and infra perf; I want comp to be at upper-mid of band for retention (we want to avoid immediate counteroffers).
- Start date: flexible. Candidate prefers 5/4 but can do as early as 4/20. I want a clause allowing up to 6 weeks flexibility for relocation / counteroffer resolution. Please add a short "flexible start" sentence rather than a hard date.
- Equity: target 0.35% (equivalent the band suggests 0.3–0.5% for Sr Infra). Advocate for 0.4% if budget allows. Standard 4y vest, 1y cliff. Consider pro-rated vesting if start is late in quarter?
- Sign-on: discretionary. Suggest $30k sign-on to bridge between base and total comp for first year; pay as cash in two installments (30/70) tied to start and 6-month retention.

Please confirm headcount/budget approval: HC-2026-0142 is approved by People Ops but final budget owner approval is Markus. Markus — can you confirm? Rishi — pls confirm comp band alignment and if we have room for 0.4% equity + $30k sign-on.

Mina / team —

Quick comp sanity check after reviewing Comp_Bands_Q1_2026.xlsx: 
- Band for Sr Infra Eng (SF): Base midpoint $210,000; range $180k–240k.
- For retention and level, recommend base $225,000, target total cash (base + bonus) $247,500 (10% target bonus).
- Equity: 0.35% base, can approve up to 0.45% for critical hires with Markus sign-off. Vesting: standard 4y with 1y cliff; no pro-rata on quarter boundaries required (we use calendar-day proration in eCF).
- Sign-on: $30k is reasonable. Recommend structure: $10k on start + $20k at 6 months, clawback if voluntary departure before 12 months. Language should describe clawback.

Budget/headcount: HC-2026-0142 shows approval from People Ops and Finance has tentatively reserved budget through Q2 headcount cap. Final spending sign-off required from Markus (cost center 3002).

I attached a redline suggestion in offer template (inline comments). Will send redline PDF after quick pass.
